reason: The house has to be repainted before the wedding anyway, and a signed finish date plus paying 70% only after I check the work is exactly what I need. I will still take two other quotes, but if their per-square-foot rate is close I would book Turbolux for the inside-and-outside job and push them for the founding ₹10,000 off.
objection: ₹2,000 a day is nothing to them if they walk off halfway and my relatives arrive to a half-painted house. And they are new in Kochi, so I have no neighbour who has used their crew.
would_change_my_mind: If the per-square-foot rate at the site visit comes in well above my other two quotes, or they will not sign a finish date at least two weeks before the wedding, I would go with someone else.
